items.prompt: The attached image is the finished pose sheet of this exact insect. Redraw this SAME sheet: the same three insects in exactly the same poses, positions, sizes and facing direction (all facing RIGHT, seen from the side), with exactly the same anatomy — body, mandibles, legs and antennae unchanged. Change ONLY the material and colours: the whole insect becomes translucent pearl-white crystal with an iridescent sheen and pale ruby eyes. The mandibles keep their thick caliper shape with ONE large inner tooth and a single pointed tip (NOT forked). Background: plain flat dark slate-navy, no ground line, no shadow under the insects. Absolutely NO text, NO captions, NO pose names, NO labels anywhere in the image. Keep the same hand-painted storybook style; soft cool moonlight, gentle rim light, subsurface glow through the thin shell plates, cold pearl palette (pearl white, pale ice blue, soft lilac, faint rose). Wide image, same proportions as the attached sheet.
